Position: .Net Developer
 Location: Everett WA
 Duration: 6-12 Month Contract
 Job Description 
 We need an Analyst/(.NET) Developer for our direct client in Everett, WA. The ideal candidate will work with System Architects and Business Analysts to understand business requirements and solutions architecture. Please submit your best Word resume for this immediate contract-to-hire position.
 Skills and Competencies : SAP Configuration experience with Web and configuration set up and scripting. Knowledge in the following: SQL, C#, .NET. Ability to assess the impact of new requirements on an existing suite of complex applications. Ability to recommend appropriate scope of requirements for large efforts. Ability to drive design discussions and configuration review meetings including business requester and development. Extensive experience with system configuration and ability to write technical specifications. Ability to provide quality and accurate deliverables. Ability to effectively manage time, prioritize work, multi-task across many assignments and delegate to others as well as monitor their work for completion. Ability to provide clear status reporting and escalation information. Technical writing skills producing clear and unambiguous deliverables. MS Office Tools (Word, Excel, Project, PowerPoint, Visio).
 Education/Experience : Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or other related discipline or equivalent work experience. 8-10 years related work experience. Experience with system development life cycle and change management.


 Syed Mohammad Asif
 408-775-7468
